2610.13247.title: What Do Audio-Language Judges of Generated Music Listen For? Four Probes with Controls from Expert Ratings
2610.13247.paper_summary: Open audio-language models are used as judges of generated music: given a clip and its text prompt, the model rates the clip, and the judge is validated by how well its ratings correlate with expert ratings. The correlation does not show what the judge responds to: the music, the text prompt, or the way the question is asked. We propose four probes that test each of these, three of them read against a control computed from the human ratings: removing the audio, replacing the clip with another model's clip for the same prompt, swapping the order of two clips in pairwise judging, and rewording the instruction. We apply them to five open judges on all 2,748 clips of MusicEval, and the last two to the SongEval songs. Without audio, no judge exceeds what the prompt alone predicts from the human ratings, and for prompt alignment every judge falls below it. With audio, every judge follows the clip it hears when rating prompt alignment, two do when rating musical quality, and the strongest judge's quality score tracks the experts' alignment rating more than their quality rating. The pairwise verdicts of the four smaller judges follow the position of a clip in the pair (its slot) rather than its quality on both rating sets. For musical quality, rewording the instruction moves the correlation of most judges as much as changing the judge. MusicEval's prompt assignment bounds any prompt-only judge at the model level. We recommend reporting the four probes with every music judge.
2610.13247.paper_summary_zh: 開放音頻語言模型被用作生成音樂的評判者：給定一段音訊及其文本提示，模型對該音訊進行評分，而評判者的有效性則取決於其評分與專家評分的相關性。這種相關性並未顯示評判者對什麼做出反應：是音樂、文本提示，還是問題的提問方式。我們提出四個探針來測試這些因素，其中三個是與從人類評分計算出的控制組進行比較：去除音頻、用另一個模型的音訊替換相同提示的音訊、在成對評判中交換兩段音訊的順序，以及重新措辭指示。我們將這些探針應用於五個開放評判者，涵蓋MusicEval的所有2,748段音訊，最後兩個則應用於SongEval的歌曲。沒有音頻時，沒有評判者的表現超過僅根據人類評分預測的提示，而在提示對齊方面，每個評判者的表現都低於該預測。有了音頻，每個評判者在評分提示對齊時都遵循他們聽到的音訊，兩個評判者在評分音樂質量時也遵循這一點，而最強的評判者的質量分數與專家的對齊評分的相關性超過了他們的質量評分。四個較小評判者的成對判決遵循音訊在對中的位置（其槽位），而不是其在兩組評分中的質量。對於音樂質量，重新措辭指示使大多數評判者的相關性變化與更換評判者一樣大。MusicEval的提示分配將任何僅基於提示的評判者限制在模型層級。我們建議在每個音樂評判者中報告這四個探針。
2610.13247.author: Mateusz Modrzejewski et.al.
